<!--
  A terminal or code window: a title bar with three round marks, then the lines. A `command` line starts with
  the prompt, an `output` line is muted. Static: the typing animation belongs to the port (TypingText contract).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { CodeLine } from "./code-window.types";

  export type CodeWindowProps = {
    title: string;
    prompt: string;
    lines: CodeLine[];
    class?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let { title, prompt, lines, class: className }: CodeWindowProps = $props();
</script>

<Box
  class={cn(
    "w-full overflow-hidden rounded bg-card text-left inset-ring inset-ring-border",
    className
  )}
  role="group"
  aria-label={title}
  data-slot="code-window"
>
  <Box class="flex items-center border-b border-border px-4 py-2">
    <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
      {title}
    </Text>
  </Box>
  <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-4 font-mono text-sm">
    {#each lines as line (line.id)}
      <ListItem
        class={cn("flex gap-2", ((line.kind === "command") ? "text-foreground" : "text-muted-foreground"))}
        data-kind={line.kind}
      >
        {#if (line.kind === "command")}
          <Inline class="select-none text-muted-foreground">
            {prompt}
          </Inline>
        {/if}
        <Inline>
          {line.text}
        </Inline>
      </ListItem>
    {/each}
  </List>
</Box>
